name: Guidance Limiter (limited interval, post-CFG and guider)
plain: Guidance only inside a sigma interval, returning the positive prediction outside. The model patch still spends the negative pass outside the window; the guider version sets cfg to 1 so it saves it.
math:
x̂ = x̂_cfg if σ_end < σ ≤ σ_start else x̂_c
Guider: s_t = 1 outside interval, s inside.

providers.author: AbstractEyes
providers.note: Interval in EDM sigma, default (0.28, 5.42]; on flow models the bounds become σ/(1+σ); the code's test is inclusive at both ends; x̂_c outside. As read, may_skip_uncond only looks at start/end percent, so the uncond pass is still computed outside the interval (same image, no speed-up), unlike its description.
